description.en: Taken from the printed row: This is a grid-powered building pour through a pipeline. Keep this cell as published. The high-rise electric row prints fine stone 200 m horizontal / 600 m vertical at 90 kW. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Read it in the Xingtai table. Do not move the same condition onto Electric Low Pressure 60, which prints 75 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, fine stone 150 m / 350 m, 13 mm stone 100 m / 300 m, 24 mm stone 80 m / 240 m, hopper 0.5 m³, Kawasaki double pump 100, 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm and 3500 kg. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. It is not a Pinjin contract record. Read it in the Xingtai table. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.
